Description

WHO WE ARE

Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000. We’re hiring mission-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Cyera's website is one of the highest-traffic touchpoints a prospect, customer, or analyst has with our story — hundreds of thousands of visitors a month — and as we scale toward $1B+ in ARR, it's earned a dedicated, strategic owner who can take it from strong to best-in-class. Conversion, visitor identification, retargeting, chat, and the handoffs between them are ready for one person to bring together into a single, coherent growth engine.

We're hiring a Director of Web Strategy to lead exactly that: a single, dedicated owner for how the website converts visitors into pipeline, how we identify and re-engage visitors who don't convert on the first visit, and how chat, SEO/AEO, and paid media connect into one coherent experience. This is a hands-on, data-driven role reporting into marketing leadership, with real budget and roadmap ownership from day one.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conversion rate optimization. Own the CRO roadmap for cyera.com — personalization on high-value pages, trust and proof signals on high-intent pages (demo, pricing), and a continuous testing program that moves our conversion rate toward best-in-class benchmarks for the category.
  • Visitor identification & retargeting. Own the strategy for profiling anonymous site traffic and converting that insight into a real retargeting motion — in partnership with our media agency — while staying ahead of cookie-deprecation and consent requirements.
  • Chat & digital experience. Own the performance of our website chat experience as a core conversion and qualification channel.
  • Web analytics & reporting. Be the single source of truth on core web KPIs — unique visitors, conversion, visitor growth, page time, demo requests, and chat performance — and report on them with the rigor this team expects.
  • Cross-functional integration. Partner with our in-house web developer, SEO/AEO team, paid media, and brand/design to keep the site's roadmap coherent rather than a queue of one-off requests.
  • Platform story on the web. Make sure the site experience reflects Cyera as an integrated AI Trust platform — not three disconnected products — from nav to conversion path.

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, you've audited the current site experience end-to-end, stood up a CRO roadmap, and can answer — with data — how much of our traffic we identify and retarget today.

By the end of year one, Cyera website is recognized as industry-best for both brand and a rich digital experience, website conversion has moved meaningfully against an ambitious, benchmarked target; the visitor-to-pipeline journey (identification, retargeting, chat, conversion) runs as one coordinated motion instead of disconnected pieces; and the website is recognized across the company as a measurable pipeline-driving asset.

Requirements

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years leading web strategy, growth, and CRO for an enterprise B2B company, ideally in cybersecurity or another technical, sales-assisted category.
  • Deep, hands-on CRO expertise — testing programs, personalization, funnel diagnosis — with real, attributable results you can show.
  • Experience building or running a visitor identification and retargeting motion, including first-party data and consent-based approaches as third-party cookies decline.
  • Working fluency in SEO and AEO/GEO fundamentals, with experience directing specialized agencies rather than needing to be the expert yourself.
  • Comfort managing or partnering closely with a web developer/technical resource to prioritize a fast-moving roadmap.
  • A metrics-first operating style — you default to data over opinion, and you can defend a roadmap with numbers.
  • Experience partnering with demand generation, paid media, and brand teams toward shared pipeline goals.

title: Data Analyst/Health Economist – US Claims & RWE
description: Do you want to be part of a company that's transforming healthcare?

raw.title: Data Analyst/Health Economist – US Claims & RWE
raw.excerpt: Do you want to be part of a company that's transforming healthcare?
raw.description:
Do you want to be part of a company that's transforming healthcare?

Lyfegen helps bridge the gap to faster, smarter access with pricing, access, and rebate management solutions. Our platform is used by health insurers, governments, hospital payers, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide to simplify the complexities of drug pricing agreements, optimize rebates, and drive better value.

As a global leader in drug access and rebate management, Lyfegen is expanding its reach and impact. As we continue to scale, we're looking for passionate professionals to join us and help shape the future of healthcare.

We're looking for a Data Analyst / Health Economist to support our US consulting team in turning claims and clinical data into insights that shape pricing and contracting decisions, while also helping keep signed value-based agreements running smoothly once they're live. This role sits across two connected workstreams, both anchored in the same underlying need: the ability to manipulate and analyze large volumes of claims data, cost sheets, spending, and utilization data.

At Lyfegen, we're tackling challenges no one has solved before. That's why we are looking for problem solvers with a proactive mindset, people who thrive on turning complexity into opportunity.

Join us and help bridge the gap to faster and smarter access to medicines for patients.

Your main responsibilities:

  • Analyze large-scale US claims data (Medicare, Medicaid, and/or commercial) and clinical datasets to support pricing and contracting recommendations, in partnership with Lyfegen's US consulting team.
  • Support the adjudication of signed value-based agreements (VBAs), using Lyfegen's proprietary tools to review claims data and identify and validate rebates the customer is eligible for.
  • Build and maintain analyses of cost sheets, spending, and utilization data to inform both strategic recommendations and day-to-day contract execution.
  • Apply health economics methods, such as cost-effectiveness modeling, budget impact modeling, and comparative effectiveness analysis, to translate raw data into decision-useful output.
  • Collaborate with the consulting and product teams to ensure analysis is client-ready, technically sound, and delivered on time.
  • Maintain rigorous QC and validation standards given the scale and complexity of claims datasets.

Who you are:

  • Comfortable analyzing large, complex, and sometimes messy healthcare datasets.
  • Working knowledge of health economics & outcomes research (HEOR) principles.
  • Hands-on experience with US claims data (Medicare, Medicaid, and/or commercial).
  • Proficient in SQL; experience with SAS, R, or Python is a strong plus.
  • Bachelor's degree or higher, with academic training in health economics, biostatistics, epidemiology, public health, or a related quantitative field; advanced degrees preferred.
  • Around 2–5 years of relevant professional experience.
  • A proactive, ownership-driven mindset suited to a fast-paced, scale-up environment.

What we offer:

  • Join a company that improves access to healthcare for patients.
  • Direct influence on the growth and success of Lyfegen.
  • A unique opportunity to work at the intersection of payers and pharma.
  • Become part of a team of international high performers.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
  • An attractive and competitive compensation package aligned with the dynamic nature of a scale-up start-up.

Senior Mulesoft Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Senior Mulesoft Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$160,000 Annually
Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced MuleSoft Developer to design, build, and operate enterprise integration solutions on the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. In this role you will own the integration lifecycle, including API design, flow development, deployment, observability, and ongoing optimization. The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on MuleSoft experience with strong API-led connectivity practices, and will partner with enterprise architects, application teams, and integration partners to deliver reliable, secure, and reusable integration assets. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop integration flows in MuleSoft Anypoint Studio, including DataWeave transformations, error handling, and reusable connectors.
  • Apply API-led connectivity (System, Process, Experience APIs) to deliver reusable, composable integration assets.
  • Design and publish well-documented APIs using API Designer and the Anypoint Exchange.
  • Configure and manage runtimes (CloudHub, Runtime Fabric, Hybrid) appropriate to workload requirements.
  • Implement strong API security using OAuth2, mTLS, JWT, and Anypoint API Manager policies.
  • Build event-driven integrations using Anypoint MQ, Salesforce Platform Events, or Kafka.
  • Optimize integration performance, including pooling, caching, parallel processing, and message size management.
  • Build CI/CD pipelines for MuleSoft applications using Maven, Anypoint CLI, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins.
  • Migrate legacy integrations from other middleware (Oracle SOA, BizTalk) to MuleSoft.
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring and alerting using Anypoint Monitoring and external observability tools.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to internal integration patterns and standards.
  • Collaborate closely with security, enterprise architecture, and application development teams, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of integration experience with strong focus on MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Anypoint Studio, DataWeave, and Mule runtime.
  • Solid understanding of API-led connectivity and RAML/OAS API design.
  • Hands-on experience with CloudHub, Runtime Fabric, or Hybrid deployment.
  • Experience with API security standards (OAuth2, mTLS, JWT) and Anypoint API Manager.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD for MuleSoft.
  • Familiarity with event-driven integration using Anypoint MQ or Kafka.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Experience integrating with major SaaS platforms (Salesforce, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow).
Preferred Qualifications
  • MuleSoft Certified Developer or Architect credentials.
  • Exposure to multi-cloud deployment of Mule runtimes.
  • Familiarity with FinOps and integration cost management.
  • Experience implementing zero-trust API security models.
  • Working knowledge of GraphQL APIs on Anypoint Platform.

O time de New Ventures é o arquiteto de crescimento do Asaas: apoia a expansão estratégica da companhia por meio de inteligência de mercado, gestão ativa das empresas adquiridas e iniciativas de inovação. raw.description:
XPUP

XPUP vznikla z jednoduché potřeby: nemohli jsme najít dostatek profesionálů s odpovídajícími digitálními dovednostmi – tak jsme se rozhodli je vychovat sami.
To, co začalo v roce 2018 jako komunitní iniciativa v Tbilisi, se proměnilo v globální vzdělávací platformu s více než 30 000 absolventy.

Naše programy tvoří experti z praxe, jsou zaměřené na skutečné potřeby trhu a vedené v prostředí spolupráce, zvídavosti a růstu.

V roce 2023 jsme se spojili s Tether, abychom naši misi rozšířili do celého světa – zpřístupnit praktické a kariérně posilující vzdělávání všem, kdo chtějí růst.

Dnes budujeme novou generaci digitálních profesionálů: marketérů, designérů, vývojářů a tvůrců, kteří nechtějí jen práci, ale i dopad.

Naše hodnoty jsou jednoduché a žité: lidé na prvním místě, zvědavost, kvalita a zodpovědnost.

A jsme teprve na začátku.

Přehled role

Do společnosti XPUP hledáme zkušeného odborníka na OSINT a korporátní bezpečnost, který se připojí k našemu týmu jako lektor kurzu OSINT (Open-Source Intelligence). Vaším úkolem bude připravovat a vést interaktivní workshopy, sdílet reálné zkušenosti z praxe a provázet studenty během celého studia. Pomůžete jim osvojit si dovednosti potřebné k tomu, aby dokázali sbírat, analyzovat a vyhodnocovat informace z otevřených zdrojů profesionálně, eticky a v souladu s právními normami.

Open-source intelligence je dnes klíčovou disciplínou v korporátní bezpečnosti, due diligence i vyšetřování. Tento kurz studentům poskytne praktické dovednosti potřebné k efektivní práci s OSINT a SOCMINT nástroji – od sběru dat ze sociálních sítí a veřejných registrů přes analýzu Dark Webu až po pokročilou síťovou rekognoskaci a geolokaci. Prostřednictvím praktických cvičení a reálných scénářů se studenti naučí pracovat s moderními nástroji i AI automatizací, porozumí etickým a právním hranicím OSINT a osvojí si zásady bezpečné a zodpovědné práce s informacemi.

Main Responsibilities

  • Sdílet se studenty své odborné znalosti a zkušenosti z praxe.

  • Připravovat a vést poutavé prezenční i online workshopy podle připravené osnovy, která propojuje teorii, praktické ukázky a interaktivní cvičení.

  • Podporovat, motivovat a provázet studenty během celého vzdělávacího procesu.

Enterprise Data Architect - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Enterprise Data Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Enterprise Data Architect to define and lead the architecture of our enterprise data platform, spanning ingestion, storage, processing, governance, and consumption layers. The role drives the strategic direction of data infrastructure, sets standards for data modeling and lifecycle management, and partners with data engineering, analytics, ML, and business stakeholders to deliver a coherent, scalable data foundation. The ideal candidate combines deep technical mastery of modern data platforms with strong architectural judgment, and has led data-platform programs of meaningful scope and complexity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define the target-state architecture of the enterprise data platform, including ingestion, storage, processing, and consumption layers.
  • Establish standards for data modeling, schema evolution, partitioning, file formats, and storage organization.
  • Architect lakehouse, warehouse, and streaming patterns leveraging technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi.
  • Design end-to-end data pipelines that balance latency, cost, reliability, and maintainability across batch and streaming workloads.
  • Lead the integration of governance, lineage, and catalog tools such as Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Unity Catalog, or DataHub.
  • Define security architecture including row- and column-level controls, masking, encryption, and identity-aware access patterns.
  • Partner with ML, BI, and product teams to ensure platform capabilities align with downstream consumption needs.
  • Establish data contract and data product principles to drive ownership, quality, and decoupling between producers and consumers.
  • Lead architecture reviews and provide guidance on pipeline and warehouse design proposals across teams.
  • Drive cost optimization and capacity planning across the data platform estate.
  • Design disaster recovery, multi-region, and high-availability strategies for critical data assets.
  • Mentor data engineers and architects on platform standards and emerging best practices.
  • Produce architecture artifacts including context diagrams, decision records, and reference patterns.
  • Stay current with data platform research, vendor offerings, and open-source ecosystem developments.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in data engineering, with significant time in architecture roles.
  • Deep expertise across at least two major data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift.
  • Strong understanding of lakehouse architectures, modern table formats, and streaming systems.
  • Hands-on experience with Spark, Flink, or Kafka at production scale.
  • Strong data modeling expertise across dimensional, normalized, and data-vault patterns.
  • Experience implementing governance, lineage, and catalog capabilities.
  • Solid grasp of cloud platforms, networking, identity, and cost optimization.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Track record of leading large data platform initiatives across teams.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with data mesh or data product architectures.
  • Familiarity with semantic layers such as dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, or LookML.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with strict data residency or audit requirements.
  • Cloud or platform certifications (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Public talks or writing on data architecture.

raw.description:
Highlights

  • Location: Portugal, Remote (CET)
  • Language:Russian-speaking team; English fluency required (C1)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building alarge and complex product ecosystemthat serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a moderncheckout experience and customizable widgets(each a standalone SPA),donor, organization, and partner portals,admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About the Role

Gift Cart is one of Fundraise Up's fastest-growing giving surfaces — it lets donors support multiple causes in a single checkout, giving nonprofits a new way to present their programmes and deepen donor engagement beyond a standard donation form. It's already live and scaling across organisations running everything from humanitarian aid to symbolic animal adoptions.

We're looking for a Product Manager to own Gift Cart end-to-end: strategy, discovery, and delivery. You'll shape the roadmap, drive adoption, and grow the metrics that matter — average order value, multi-designation rate, and reliability — while safeguarding the payment and ledger correctness, risk posture, and operability that a financial product demands. This is a full-lifecycle role: you'll go from strategic thinking to engineering-ready specs to launch, working closely with engineering, risk, and design along the way.

If you enjoy owning a product from "why does this matter" through to "it's live and working," this is built for that.

What You’ll Own

  • Define the Gift Cart strategy and translate it into a roadmap — with clear priorities and reasoning behind every decision.
  • Communicate with customers and CSMs regularly, and analyze data together with the analytics team — to find growth opportunities and make informed decisions.
  • Write specifications that engineers can build from — with detailed requirements and edge cases covered.
  • Take features from idea to launch, working closely with design and engineering at every step.
  • Track product health and growth: conversion, average gift size, error rates — and understand what's driving them.
  • Prepare CSMs and Sales for every launch so they're always in context ahead of time.
  • Keep stakeholders aligned — on priorities, timelines, and changes in plans.

Requirements

  • Experience owning a product area end-to-end — you take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.
  • Ability to build a strategy and roadmap for 12–24 months — and clearly explain the reasoning behind your decisions.
  • Data-driven: you analyze funnels, understand the numbers, and know where to look for growth opportunities.
  • You write specifications engineers can build from — clear, with edge cases covered and no open questions left.
  • Systems thinker: you see the product as a whole, understand dependencies, and anticipate the impact of decisions.
  • Strong UX sensibility: you know what makes an experience good and can advocate for it with your team.
  • Comfortable working across functions — design, engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.

Nice To Have

  • Experience in e-commerce or products with multi-step checkout flows.
  • Experience working with nonprofits, donors, or in the fundraising industry.
  • Experience with payment flows or financial products.

Working model

  • High ownership and direct collaboration with dedicated Engineering TL, Engineers, Designer, Analyst and CSM, Sales teams.
  • We use AI to accelerate analysis, specs, and communication — with clear assumptions and validation.

At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool — not an experimental one

We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. You should already be using AI meaningfully in your work and understand where it adds value and how it can improve the way you operate.

Why work with us

  • A strong, collaborative product team that owns what it builds
  • Clear product vision and access to real customer feedback from global nonprofit leaders
  • Flat structure: no politics, just great work with great people
  • Transparent company culture-we share how we’re growing, where revenue comes from, and what’s next
  • Long-term focus: we offer equity options and value sustained, meaningful contribution

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is €5,200 - €5,700 gross.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance for the employee and their family
  • 22 paid vacation days per year
  • Up to 14 paid public holidays per year
  • 5 company-paid sick leave days
  • English learning courses.
  • Relevant professional education.
  • Gym or swimming pool.
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace.
  • Co-working.
  • Remote working.
  • €50 monthly allowance to cover internet and mobile phone expenses

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

raw.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Infrastructure Security Engineering - DGX Cloud
raw.excerpt: NVIDIA DGX Cloudis the AI supercomputing-as-a-service substrate designed to power the next generation of AI and industrial-scale breakthroughs.
raw.description:
NVIDIA DGX Cloudis the AI supercomputing-as-a-service substrate designed to power the next generation of AI and industrial-scale breakthroughs. As an Engineering Manager within our Infrastructure Security Engineering organization, you will enable the engineers who secure a GPU fleet numbering in the hundreds of thousands. Your team does not write reports about risk. It engineers whole classes of risk out of existence, and delivers the result as paved roads the rest of DGX Cloud will happily take.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Grow the Team:Manage, coach, and develop a distributed team of senior security and infrastructure engineers. You own hiring, growth, and performance, and you build a bench deep enough that our capability never rests on one person. Heroics signal a system that needs fixing, so you protect sustainable pace.

  • Set Technical Direction:Partner with your engineers on the roadmap for our security control plane, our foundational security services, and the path toward autonomous security operations. Leadership owns the mission and the strategy; the team owns the execution.

  • Deliver Outcomes, Not Tickets:Run a lightweight planning rhythm where the team commits to a result and the reason it matters, then reflects openly on what to change next. We are measured by the risks we eliminate, not the tickets we close.

  • Assemble Teams Around the Work:Staff each effort with the smallest group who can deliver it, and a clear owner accountable for landing it. Teams form around the work and dissolve when it's done. Make that motion fast, fair, and a real growth opportunity.

  • Raise the Engineering Bar:Hold a high standard for what "done" means: tested code, observability, operational readiness, and documentation someone who didn't build the system can operate from. AI-assisted work ships with real human ownership behind it.

  • Communicate Risk Upward:Translate a complex, fast-moving risk picture into something executives can act on. Declare the unknowns honestly, turn risk assessment into measurable themes, and make trade-offs legible to the people funding them.

  • Multi-Functional Collaboration:Build the partnerships that make the work land. We operate horizontally across vertically organized teams, with influence rather than authority. Your credibility with DGX Cloud platform, SRE, networking, and broader NVIDIA security partners is a delivery mechanism, not a nicety.

What We Need to See:

We are looking for high-caliber engineering leaders with deep spikes of expertise in a few of these areas and the intellectual curiosity to dive into the rest. If your experience aligns with the core of this role—building and growing teams that engineer risk out of existence—and you can show us how, we want to hear from you!

  • Engineering Management:Experience (typically 7+ years) managing engineers, within a broader career (typically 14+ years) across software engineering, SRE, infrastructure, or security. You have grown people, not only shipped projects.

  • Technical Credibility:Enough hands-on depth in infrastructure, distributed systems, or security engineering to earn the trust of senior engineers. You can review a design honestly and recognize when an estimate doesn't add up. You don't need to be the best engineer in the room; you need to build the room.

  • Hiring and Developing Talent:A history of attracting, hiring, and growing excellent engineers, including people far more expert than you in their domain. You build interview and calibration practices that make hiring repeatable and fair.

  • Delivery Under Ambiguity:You can take a high-stakes, loosely defined mandate and turn it into sequenced, measurable delivery. You are comfortable proving a model on a few systems first, then using that success to expand.

  • Cloud-Native and Security Fluency:Working understanding of cloud-native architecture, container orchestration (Kubernetes), identity and access, policy enforcement, and vulnerability management—enough to build it and ask the questions that matter.

  • Influence Without Authority:Experience delivering through partner teams you do not own, in environments where relationships, not org charts, determine whether the work ships.

  • Foundation:Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).

Ways To Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • HPC/AI Infrastructure:Experience running teams that secure or operate high-performance computing environments, large GPU fleets, or multi-tenant platforms at cloud scale.

  • Security as an Internal Product:You have delivered security or infrastructure capabilities with real adoption metrics, where teams took the paved road because it was the easiest path.

  • Building a Function from Scratch:Experience standing up a team, a practice, or an engineering culture where none existed—charter, agreements, rituals, and all.

  • Scaling Without Dilution:A history of growing a team quickly while the bar went up rather than down.How have you scaled a team and raised the standard at the same time?

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 245,000 CAD - 295,000 CAD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 8, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Reporting to the CMO, you will lead the development and execution of CALI’s educational strategy, ensuring our programs provide practical, technically accurate, and legally sound guidance for lawyers and legal professionals.

This role requires an attorney who can understand and explain the legal nuances behind complex topics, including discovery obligations, privilege, proportionality, defensibility, Technology Assisted Review (TAR), analytics, Generative AI, information governance, investigations, privacy, cybersecurity, and evolving legal technology workflows. You will oversee CALI’s full portfolio, including webinars, CLE programs, practice guides, white papers, research initiatives, client education programs, and CALI Symposium. You will work closely with subject matter experts across Consilio to transform deep legal and technical expertise into educational experiences that help clients and practitioners navigate an increasingly complex legal landscape. CALI currently serves as Consilio’s center for thought leadership, research, and education through educational content, practical guidance, CLE programming, webinars, and Symposium.

Our culture is built on the Power of And—combining innovation with insight, scale with agility, and precision with compassion.

The 1LMX Space ERP Testing Coordinator role reports to the 1LMX Space ERP Finance lead and will own the end‑to‑end testing strategy, planning, execution, and governance for all Central Finance (including Capital, Resource Management, Accounting, and Compliance) across a large‑scale ERP implementation. As part of LM's overall strategic 1LMX (OneLM Transformation) initiative this position will play a significant role in evolving our capabilities and reshaping our operations.
The testing coordinator role includes but is not limited to the following:

  • Supports SAP S4/HANA data conversion strategy primarily through testing, as well as data mapping, cleansing, and functional specification review, where applicable.
  • Quickly gains understanding of financial systems and Central Finance processes.
  • Helps maintain the test plan and test schedule, ensuring alignment with overall ERP rollout milestones.

raw.description:
About Anovium

Anovium is a technology consultancy that transforms operations through intelligent innovation. We specialize in helping logistics, transportation, and distribution companies modernize their operations while building foundations for future growth. By combining deep industry expertise with technical innovation, we deliver practical solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

» Our Approach

We believe in the power of practical innovation. We focus on real results - helping traditional industries embrace modern technology without disrupting what makes them successful. Our approach is rooted in understanding your business first, then applying technology to solve real challenges.

» Our Culture

At Anovium, we're building a team of experts who understand both technology and industry. We value:
- Deep expertise paired with continuous learning
- Practical innovation over theoretical possibilities
- Long-term partnerships built on measurable results
- Balance of technical excellence and human understanding

» Who We're Looking For

We seek professionals who combine technical expertise with industry understanding. The ideal Anovium team member:
- Thrives on transforming complex business challenges into elegant solutions
- Values both technical excellence and practical business outcomes
- Brings a partnership mentality to client relationships
- Has a genuine interest in logistics, transportation, or healthcare technology
- Embraces our philosophy of sophisticated innovation with practical impact
Our team members don't just implement technology – they help traditional industries embrace the future while understanding their foundations. If you're excited about bringing meaningful technological transformation to established industries, we want to talk to you.
TL/DR: You're in charge of guiding successful deliveries of projects and owning high level communications with clients, business partners, and the delivery team.
Opportunity: Play an important role by managing delivery teams in staying on task and meeting timelines for projects. Manage progress and status communications with stakeholders/clients.You’ll be the fluid interface between the bird’s eye view and the nitty gritty. You’re in charge of unity and collaboration by instituting operational excellence. You'll lead sprints while balancing immediate and long-term visions.
Functionally, you will coordinate meetings, bring in technical experts when needed, and effectively communicate with stakeholders. This includes being involved in the discovery process to uncover needs, wants, and problems; managing client expectations and ensuring the delivery of solutions; and encouraging a collaborative work environment for a diverse cast of team members to prevent knowledge silos and the loss of information. If and when problems arise, you will encourage the team and clients to weigh different approaches and methods before rushing to apply bandages.

What You'll Do

  • Orchestrate Delivery. You’ll be taking ownership of deliveries in alignment with product goals and customer satisfaction.
  • Direct Communications. You’ll coordinate across the team, stakeholders, and clients regarding active work, priorities, backlog, blockers, and risks.
  • Plan & Prioritize. You'll work with stakeholders and developers to continuously prioritize and plan work, balancing urgency with importance. You’ll facilitate sprint planning, leading teams to dig into the whats, whys, and hows. Sprints often operate at 1-2 week intervals; however, strategic goals and visions span longer cycles.
  • Define the Scope. You'll ensure that projects go through a proper discovery process. You will see and map out the forest and the trees, translating the unearthed project ideals into defined goals and requirements.
  • Be the Task Keeper. You'll do what it takes to support and facilitate projects to keep them on task.
  • Monitor and Track. You'll leverage reporting tools such as OKRs to track and relay progress.
  • Make an Impact. You’ll be working with small teams. Your actions, decisions, and communication will have a large and direct impact on the shaping of deliverables, Anovium itself, and the business future of our clients.

Who You Are

  • Adaptable and Dynamic. You are able to manage different projects and people, shifting priorities as new information and situations arise.
  • An Expert in Group Dynamics. Diversity is a strength, as long as it's recognized. You can reach people from different schools of thought and work styles and get them on the same page.
  • Organized. Very Organized. You’re that person who everyone says is always on the ball, and you're able to leverage modern toolsets to ensure it.
  • Analytical and quantitative. You have the patience to understand technical challenges and motivation to keep up with current industry trends and pitfalls to better understand risk/reward scenarios. This allows you to make timely decisions and recommendations.
  • Emotionally Intelligent. Your EQ is high and your interpersonal skills are strong.
  • A Creator of Value. You’re obsessed with the creation and delivery of value.
  • Successful in Fast-Paced Environments. Anovium has an environment of high iteration. At times, this can cause uncertainty. You aren’t held back by the fear of being wrong or making a mistake, and you are comfortable managing team members operating with the same freedom to make mistakes and learn.
  • A Strong Leader. You’re passionate. You take pride in your ability to empathetically lead teams to a shared goal. You forge alignment among stakeholders and teams through common reason and firm decision-making.
  • Candid but Respectful. You are capable of helping others confront uncomfortable truths. You admit mistakes and openly disagree while explaining why.

Excited but Not a 100% Fit?

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you're excited about this role and have a strong background in sales, business development, or account management, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and varied experiences that contribute to our team's success.

Description

We are looking for an experienced and entrepreneurial Regional Sales Director to own the company's go-to-market strategy and revenue growth within a defined region.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong B2B enterprise sales experience, a solid understanding of capital markets and financial institutions, and the ability to build a market from the ground up. You will be responsible for developing relationships with banks, brokerages, asset managers, wealth platforms, and other financial institutions, while building the local partnerships, processes, and team required to scale the company in the region.

We are looking for people who are highly independent, commercially driven, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving startup environment. You should be someone who can identify opportunities, open doors, build processes from scratch, and take ownership beyond the traditional boundaries of a sales role.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and execute the regional go-to-market strategy, including target accounts, market segmentation, competitive positioning, partnerships, and sales priorities.
  • Own regional revenue targets and take full responsibility for market growth.
  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle for strategic accounts, from prospecting and first meetings through negotiation and signed contracts.
  • Proactively identify and bring in new customers across banks, brokerages, asset managers, wealth platforms, and other financial institutions.
  • Build sales processes, market-entry strategies, and commercial activities from scratch when entering or developing a new region.
  • Develop and manage local partnerships that support pipeline generation, market credibility, and business development.
  • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers across financial institutions.
  • Represent the company in meetings with senior executives, commercial stakeholders, and technology teams.
  • Understand customer needs and communicate the company's offering within the context of capital markets, financial data, APIs, iframe integrations, and B2B technology solutions.
  • Work closely with Product, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships, and other internal teams to move opportunities forward and support customers.
  • Take ownership of opportunities and business needs even when they fall outside the traditional scope of the role.
  • Hire, coach, and manage regional sales talent as the market grows.
  • Build and maintain an active network of relevant contacts within the region.
  • Provide regular reporting on pipeline, forecasts, market developments, competitive activity, and overall regional progress to global leadership.

Requirements

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise, institutional, or B2B sales, ideally within Fintech, Capital Markets, Financial Data, WealthTech, or B2B SaaS.
  • Proven track record of closing complex, high-value B2B deals.
  • Experience selling to or working with banks, brokerages, asset managers, wealth platforms, or other financial institutions.
  • Strong understanding of the capital markets ecosystem and the ability to communicate comfortably using relevant financial and technical terminology.
  • Ability to understand and discuss technology concepts relevant to the sales process, including APIs, iframe integrations, data platforms, and B2B software integrations.
  • Strong understanding of markets, customer structures, buying processes, and commercial decision-making.
  • Existing network of relevant contacts within the target region.
  • Proven ability to build sales processes, pipelines, partnerships, and market presence from scratch.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong ability to identify opportunities and turn them into commercial results.
  • Highly autonomous and comfortable operating with significant ownership in a fast-moving startup environment.
  • Willingness to take initiative and handle responsibilities outside the strict boundaries of the role when needed.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Excellent English, with the ability to lead high-level business conversations and negotiations.
  • Fluent in the primary language of the relevant region.

Help us build the next generation of renewals at Sembi.

Sembi is the parent company behind leading software quality and DevOps brands including TestRail, Xray, Testmo, Ranorex, PreEmptive, and Kiuwan. Our products help development, QA, and security teams build, test, secure, and ship better software with confidence.

We’re bringing these businesses together to create a stronger, more connected customer experience while preserving the unique strengths of each brand. As we continue to grow, we’re investing in the capabilities that will help us build lasting customer relationships, and renewals is at the heart of that mission.

The Role

We’re looking for a Director of Renewals to lead our global renewals organization across the Sembi portfolio.

This is an opportunity to build and lead a world-class renewals function spanning six established software brands and thousands of customers around the world. You’ll own the strategy, operating model, forecasting, performance, and team responsible for protecting Sembi’s recurring revenue and strengthening customer retention.

This isn’t a role focused simply on processing renewals. We’re looking for someone who can transform renewals into a predictable, data driven, customer centric revenue engine.

You’ll report to the VP of Customer Experience and work closely with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Finance, Operations, Product, and Marketing leaders across Sembi.

What You'll Own

  • Lead Sembi’s global renewals strategy across TestRail, Xray, Testmo, Ranorex, PreEmptive, and Kiuwan, owning retention performance, renewal bookings, churn, contraction, and overall renewal outcomes.
  • Build a predictable renewals engine with consistent methodologies, processes, playbooks, and operating rhythms across brands and customer segments.
  • Own the renewals pipeline and CRM discipline, establishing clear standards for opportunity management, renewal stages, close dates, risk identification, and data quality.
  • Drive forecasting and executive visibility, building reliable renewal forecasts, dashboards, and reporting that clearly communicate pipeline health, risks, trends, and expected outcomes.
  • Identify and mitigate renewal risk early, partnering with Customer Success and other teams to develop proactive strategies for at-risk customers and prevent avoidable churn.
  • Use data and customer insights to improve retention, analyzing churn, contraction, renewal performance, and customer trends across products, segments, and geographies to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high performing global renewals team, establishing clear goals, accountability, performance expectations, and career development.
  • Partner across the business with Customer Success, Support, Sales, Finance, Operations, Product, and Marketing to create a connected customer lifecycle and seamless renewal experience.
  • Improve systems, automation, and operational efficiency, partnering with Operations and Finance to strengthen CRM data, system integrations, workflows, and reporting.
  • Evolve the renewals function into a strategic revenue discipline, continuously raising the bar on predictability, productivity, customer retention, and scalable growth.

What You Bring

  • Significant experience leading SaaS renewals, customer success, account management, or another recurring revenue function.
  • Proven success improving retention and reducing churn at scale.
  • Experience managing a substantial recurring revenue portfolio and renewal forecast.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics including GRR, NRR, churn, contraction, ARR, and forecast accuracy.
  • Experience building or transforming renewal processes and operating models.
  • Strong analytical, strategic, and operational skills.
  • Exceptional cross functional leadership and communication abilities.
  • A track record of building and developing high performing teams.
  • Comfort working across multiple products, customer segments, and geographies.
  • A builder's mindset: you see ambiguity as an opportunity to create something better.

Why This Role?

This is a chance to have portfolio level impact.

You won’t be responsible for renewals for just one product. You’ll help define how six established Sembi brands retain and grow their customer relationships. You’ll have the visibility and influence to shape strategy, improve how we operate, develop a global team, and directly impact one of the most important drivers of our business.

If you’re an experienced renewals leader who loves building teams, creating predictability, solving complex problems, and turning customer retention into a competitive advantage, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Controller to lead accounting operations, financial reporting, compliance, internal controls, and finance team performance.

You’ll work closely with executive leadership and FP&A to maintain accurate financials, strengthen accounting operations, and translate financial data into actionable business insights.

If you combine deep technical accounting expertise with strong leadership skills and can balance financial control with strategic decision support, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Month-End & Year-End Close

  • Own monthly, quarterly, and year-end close processes
  • Drive a 5-business-day month-end close
  • Review and approve:
    • Journal entries
    • Accruals
    • Balance sheet reconciliations
    • Supporting schedules
  • Ensure general ledger accuracy and completeness
  • Prepare and review consolidated:
    • Profit & Loss Statements
    • Balance Sheets
    • Cash Flow Statements

    • Investor reporting
    • Executive dashboards
    • Management reporting

Internal Controls, Audit & Compliance

  • Manage and coordinate external audit processes

  • Proactively identify financial, accounting, and compliance risks

Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Analyze financial performance against plans

  • Provide accounting and financial insights for strategic initiatives
  • Help leadership understand financial risks, opportunities, and trade-offs

Treasury & Cash Management

Accounting Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and manage accountants and finance team members

  • Develop team capabilities and strengthen accounting discipline
  • Establish high standards for:
    • Accuracy
    • Timeliness
    • Documentation
    • Accountability
  • Build a high-performing and reliable accounting function

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Identify inefficiencies across accounting and reporting workflows
  • Lead or support ERP implementations and system improvements
  • Automate repetitive accounting and reporting processes
  • Develop and improve financial SOPs
  • Strengthen scalability as transaction volume and organizational complexity increase

Requirements

  • Strong knowledge of GAAP and/or IFRS
  • Proven experience owning month-end and year-end close
  • Strong financial statement preparation and reporting experience
  • Experience designing or maintaining internal controls
  • Experience supporting or managing external audits
  • Hands-on experience with ERP/accounting systems such as:

    • SAP

    • QuickBooks Enterprise

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication

Nice to Have

  • CPA, ACCA, MBA, or equivalent professional qualification
  • Previous experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Finance Manager
  • ERP implementation or accounting system migration experience
  • M&A integration experience
  • Multi-entity or consolidated accounting experience
  • Background in:
    • SaaS
    • Professional Services
    • Real Estate
  • Experience with BI and reporting platforms such as:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Polish Games Translation & Localization Specialist to join our world-class localization team. In this role, you’ll translate and localize gaming content into Polish with exceptional linguistic quality, cultural relevance, and attention to detail. You’ll collaborate with fellow localization specialists and cross-functional partners to deliver accurate, engaging content for players and customers.

This role is ideal for someone who combines deep Polish language expertise with a genuine passion for gaming. You’ll work across new releases, marketing materials, support content, and other customer-facing communications while managing changing priorities and occasional last-minute updates.

  • Collaborate closely with other translators, reviewers, project teams, and stakeholders.
  • Stay informed about gaming terminology, genres, platforms, hardware, and player communities.
  • Contribute to a team culture focused on quality, continuous improvement, innovation, and shared success.

raw.description:
Nex is on a mission to help families rediscover the joy of movement. Created by parents for parents, Nex combines technology and play to deliver fun, social, and interactive experiences powered by natural body motion, encouraging kids and adults to move more, play more, and have fun together. Nex Playground, the company’s award-winning active play system, is purpose-built to get families moving year-round, with safety and privacy as core considerations in its intentional design. It is certified kidSAFE+ COPPA compliant and built to support healthy, active play for all ages and abilities.

Nex Playground features a growing library of 50+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. Content includes collaborations with partners like Hasbro, Sesame Workshop, and NBCUniversal. Nex has been recognized by Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, TIME’s Best Inventions, and Parents’ Best Entertainment System for Families, and has earned Red Dot, IDEA, and Core77 international design awards. We encourage you to explore Have Fun and Is Motion Gaming Back?, as they offer a deeper look into our culture, values, and explain how our approach to motion gaming differs from previous generations.

To protect yourself from recruitment scams, please note that Nex communicates through official company emails ending in @nex.inc. If you receive a suspicious email or message, please do not respond and report it immediately to us.

Location: Remote
Annual salary:USD 150,000 - USD 180,000
Type: Full-time
Reports to: General Counsel

About the Role

We're hiring our firstSr Manager/Director, Legal Operationsto serve as the front door of Legal at Nex Playground and to design and build the operational infrastructure the company will need over the next 18 months and beyond.The role may be leveled at Sr Manager or Director based on the candidate’s experience and demonstrated scope. Reporting directly to the General Counsel, you will be the first dedicated legal operations hire in the company. You will work in partnership with the GC and business leaders to define our target operating model, and build the systems, processes, and technology that let Legal, and the business it supports, move fast.

This is a builder's role with real breadth. You'll lead the rollout of our first contract lifecycle management (CLM) system, stand up corporate governance rhythms, own legal aspects of our international entities, and build the playbooks and templates. You'll also spend real time in the weeds triaging requests, coordinating signatures, and being the person the rest of the company calls first, while building the systems that reduce how much of that falls on you over time.

The work is heavily corporate and commercial: retail and distribution agreements, vendor and supply chain contracts, brand licensing deals, NDAs, and the corporate housekeeping that comes with a fast-growing, increasingly international hardware + software company.

What You'll Do

Legal Intake & Contract Operations

  • Be the front door of Legal: own intake for all incoming legal requests, triage and route them appropriately, track status, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
  • Lead implementation of our first CLM system (Spotdraft or Ironclad), including workflow design, templates, approval routing, finance and e-signature integration, and reporting.
  • Build our formal contract lifecycle from the ground up: drafting support, redlining coordination, approvals, execution, and repository/renewal tracking for NDAs, vendor agreements, retail and distribution contracts, and brand licensing agreements.
  • Design a template and playbook library for our highest-volume agreement types, in partnership with the GC and Commercial Counsel, so the business can self-serve on lower-risk requests.
  • Establish signature and approval workflows, including delegation of authority guidelines, e-signature administration (e.g., DocuSign), and coordination of notarization where needed.
  • Own Nex's employment-related form library (offer letters, standard employment agreements, contractor agreements, separation agreements, and similar templates), keeping them current and legally sound. People/HR populates and issues these day-to-day; you own the underlying template and update it as law or company policy changes.

Corporate Governance & Entity Management

  • Support corporate governance motions: track board and committee meeting materials, minutes, and written consents in partnership with the GC and CFO.
  • Maintain the corporate minute book, equity documentation, and corporate records, and coordinate with Finance/People on cap table accuracy and equity administration touchpoints (option grants, 409A timing).
  • Manage legal aspects of Nex's growing family of international entities: formations, dissolutions, foreign qualifications, registered agents, and local corporate filings as we expand into new markets.
  • Own trademark and brand licensing docketing: track licensor obligations, renewal deadlines, and brand compliance requirements across our partnership and licensing agreements, and maintain our internal trademark portfolio calendar.
  • [Manage the corporate insurance program (general liability, product liability, cyber, D&O): track renewals, coordinate broker relationships, and issue certificates of insurance for retail and distribution partners.]

Cross-Functional & Compliance Support

  • Administer vendor and outside counsel relationships: onboarding, billing oversight, budget tracking, and performance check-ins across the legal team's matters. You own the administrative layer; each attorney directs substantive strategy on their own active matters.
  • Build the legal team's knowledge management and document repository and establish a records retention policy.
  • Stand up legal metrics and reporting: request volume, cycle times, contract turnaround, and outside counsel spend, to give leadership visibility into how Legal is performing.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to speed up contract review, intake triage, and self-service for common requests.
  • Partner cross-functionally to understand client needs and workflows and build processes that make Legal a fast, trusted partner to the business.
  • [Coordinate documentation for hardware compliance and trade requirements as needed - customs paperwork, safety/regulatory certification records, and import/export documentation - alongside outside counsel, Commercial Counsel, and Product/Supply Chain.]
  • [Support the operational side of Nex's privacy program (e.g., data mapping, vendor DPA tracking, policy version control) in partnership with, and under the substantive direction of, Product Counsel, who owns the privacy program.]
  • Support the operational execution of Nex’s Trust & Safety program, including policy lifecycle management, program and project management, risk and issue tracking, governance processes, metrics and reporting, documentation, vendor management, and cross-functional coordination, in partnership with and under the substantive direction of the Trust & Safety leader and Legal.

What You'll Bring

  • 5-7+ years of experience in legal operations, corporate/contracts paralegal work, or a similar operational role - ideally including time at a high-growth startup or consumer products/hardware company.
  • A genuine builder's mentality: you've stood up processes, systems, and governance rhythms where none existed, not just optimized an existing playbook.
  • Hands-on experience administering a CLM or similar workflow system (Ironclad, SpotDraft, DocuSign CLM, or comparable); direct Spotdraft or Ironclad experience is a strong plus.
  • Experience supporting corporate governance (board materials, minutes, entity management) at a private company, ideally including multi-entity or international structures.
  • Comfort working across a genuinely broad scope - intake triage, contract drafting support, governance, entity management, insurance, and vendor management - without needing a narrow lane.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to juggle high-volume day-to-day requests and longer-term build projects at the same time.
  • Excellent judgment, discretion, and comfort handling sensitive and confidential business, board, and customer information.
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills and the instinct to make Legal's processes easy for the rest of the company to follow.
  • Curiosity about applying AI tools to legal operations work, and a bias toward pragmatic, scrappy solutions over heavyweight process.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in consumer hardware, consumer electronics, gaming, or toy/kids' products.
  • Familiarity with retail and distribution contracting, brand/IP licensing agreements, or international expansion and entity setup.
  • Experience supporting a fundraise, board of directors, or investor reporting cadence at a venture-backed company.
  • Notary Public commission (or willingness to obtain one).
  • Exposure to privacy or children's data compliance frameworks (e.g., COPPA), or to product safety/import-export compliance for physical goods.

What Success Looks Like

  • The business has one clear front door for legal requests, with predictable turnaround times.
  • Nex's first CLM system is live, with templates and workflows covering the highest-volume agreement types.
  • Corporate governance, entity management, and trademark docketing run on a reliable calendar instead of being reconstructed reactively.
  • Outside counsel spend and performance are visible and managed, not a black box.
  • The GC and attorneys spend materially less time on administrative and process work than they did before this role existed.

We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Flexible working hours and vacation policy.
  • Product-driven culture that treasures talents and individual growth.
  • Front-row seat and hands-on experience with cutting edge technologies in the evolving gaming field

Nex is located in San Jose, California, USA and Hong Kong. Learn more about us at nex.inc/who-we-are.

We encourage applications even if you don’t meet more than 50% of the requirements — we believe that experience comes in many forms!

This policy applies to all individuals at every stage of the employment relationship, including all current and prospective employees, and covers all employment decisions including recruitment, hiring, job assignment, promotion, compensation, benefits, training, discipline and termination.

We are committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment and to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees.

Fractional Lead Marketing Manager (6–8 Hours per Week) – FinTech / Remote

PLEASE READ THE FULL JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING

Location: Remote
Working Pattern: Fractional – approximately 6–8 hours per week
Environment: Early-Stage FinTech

About the Opportunity

Our client is an early-stage FinTech business developing technology designed to improve access to financial services for businesses operating internationally.

The company is entering an important stage of its development and is building out its leadership and functional capability as it moves towards greater commercial readiness and growth.

As part of this next phase, the business is looking for a Fractional Lead Marketing Manager who can take meaningful ownership of its developing marketing function.

This is not a traditional marketing-management position within an established department.

You will be joining an early-stage organisation where positioning, messaging, channels, content and marketing processes are still developing. You will therefore need to be equally comfortable thinking strategically and personally executing the work required to turn that strategy into activity.

The opportunity is particularly suited to an ambitious marketing professional who is ready for broader functional ownership, enjoys building rather than inheriting, and wants the opportunity to demonstrate their ability within an early-stage FinTech environment.

Further details regarding the engagement and participation structure will be discussed directly with candidates progressing through the process.

Application – Mandatory Qualifying Questions

Please submit your CV together with a cover letter. Within your cover letter, you must answer each of the mandatory qualifying questions below.

  1. What experience do you have within B2B marketing, FinTech, financial services or another complex technology environment?
  2. Please provide an example of a marketing strategy, campaign or go-to-market initiative that you personally helped create and execute. What did you personally do and what was the outcome?
  3. What experience do you have developing positioning, messaging and content for complex B2B products or services?
  4. Please provide an example of marketing activity that you personally executed rather than delegated to a team or agency.
  5. What experience do you have generating measurable commercial outcomes such as qualified pipeline, customer engagement, partnerships, adoption or revenue?
  6. What experience do you have working within an early-stage or resource-conscious organisation where you were required to operate without a large established marketing team or budget?
  7. Do you have experience within FinTech, payments, banking, lending, trade finance or another regulated financial-services environment? Please explain.
  8. This opportunity requires approximately 6–8 hours per week. Can you consistently commit to this level of involvement alongside your other professional commitments?

These questions are mandatory and form part of our initial assessment process. Applications that do not provide a clear answer to every mandatory qualifying question will be automatically disqualified and will not be considered further in the recruitment process.

What You'll Be Doing

You will help build and lead the company's developing marketing capability, including:

  • Developing and executing the marketing plan
  • Refining market positioning, messaging and value proposition
  • Supporting go-to-market activity
  • Creating and coordinating content across relevant channels
  • Developing the company's digital and professional market presence
  • Supporting thought leadership and founder-led marketing
  • Developing communications for different audiences and stakeholders
  • Supporting commercial, partnership and customer-facing initiatives
  • Helping translate complex financial and technical concepts into clear external narratives
  • Identifying appropriate marketing channels and testing their effectiveness
  • Developing appropriate campaign and content calendars
  • Establishing marketing metrics and reporting
  • Using data and market feedback to improve activity
  • Helping determine future marketing resource and capability requirements as the organisation grows

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity. You should expect to personally execute activity rather than simply develop strategy for others to deliver.

What We're Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Strong B2B marketing experience
  • Experience taking meaningful ownership of marketing activity
  • Strong positioning and messaging capability
  • Excellent written communication skills
  • Experience creating and executing marketing plans
  • Strong commercial instincts
  • Experience working with senior leaders or founders
  • Confidence marketing technically or financially complex propositions
  • Experience operating within early-stage or high-growth environments
  • The ability to prioritise effectively when resources are limited
  • The willingness to remain hands-on while taking increasing functional ownership
  • The ability to make meaningful impact within approximately 6–8 hours per week

Experience within FinTech, financial services, payments, banking, B2B technology or another regulated environment would be particularly valuable.

We are more interested in demonstrable capability, ownership and results than job title or corporate seniority.

Engagement Structure

This is a flexible, fractional engagement of approximately 6–8 hours per week within an early-stage FinTech venture.

It is designed for someone who understands the nature of participating in an early-stage business and is comfortable with a structure centred on longer-term participation in company growth rather than a conventional package at this stage.

The role can therefore be undertaken alongside other compatible professional commitments.

Full details of the participation structure will be discussed with candidates progressing through the process.

raw.description:
Fractional Lead Marketing Manager (6–8 Hours per Week) – FinTech / Remote

PLEASE READ THE FULL JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING

Location: Remote
Working Pattern: Fractional – approximately 6–8 hours per week
Environment: Early-Stage FinTech

About the Opportunity

Our client is an early-stage FinTech business developing technology designed to improve access to financial services for businesses operating internationally.

The company is entering an important stage of its development and is building out its leadership and functional capability as it moves towards greater commercial readiness and growth.

As part of this next phase, the business is looking for a Fractional Lead Marketing Manager who can take meaningful ownership of its developing marketing function.

This is not a traditional marketing-management position within an established department.

You will be joining an early-stage organisation where positioning, messaging, channels, content and marketing processes are still developing. You will therefore need to be equally comfortable thinking strategically and personally executing the work required to turn that strategy into activity.

The opportunity is particularly suited to an ambitious marketing professional who is ready for broader functional ownership, enjoys building rather than inheriting, and wants the opportunity to demonstrate their ability within an early-stage FinTech environment.

Further details regarding the engagement and participation structure will be discussed directly with candidates progressing through the process.

Application – Mandatory Qualifying Questions

Please submit your CV together with a cover letter. Within your cover letter, you must answer each of the mandatory qualifying questions below.

  1. What experience do you have within B2B marketing, FinTech, financial services or another complex technology environment?
  2. Please provide an example of a marketing strategy, campaign or go-to-market initiative that you personally helped create and execute. What did you personally do and what was the outcome?
  3. What experience do you have developing positioning, messaging and content for complex B2B products or services?
  4. Please provide an example of marketing activity that you personally executed rather than delegated to a team or agency.
  5. What experience do you have generating measurable commercial outcomes such as qualified pipeline, customer engagement, partnerships, adoption or revenue?
  6. What experience do you have working within an early-stage or resource-conscious organisation where you were required to operate without a large established marketing team or budget?
  7. Do you have experience within FinTech, payments, banking, lending, trade finance or another regulated financial-services environment? Please explain.
  8. This opportunity requires approximately 6–8 hours per week. Can you consistently commit to this level of involvement alongside your other professional commitments?

These questions are mandatory and form part of our initial assessment process. Applications that do not provide a clear answer to every mandatory qualifying question will be automatically disqualified and will not be considered further in the recruitment process.

What You'll Be Doing

You will help build and lead the company's developing marketing capability, including:

  • Developing and executing the marketing plan
  • Refining market positioning, messaging and value proposition
  • Supporting go-to-market activity
  • Creating and coordinating content across relevant channels
  • Developing the company's digital and professional market presence
  • Supporting thought leadership and founder-led marketing
  • Developing communications for different audiences and stakeholders
  • Supporting commercial, partnership and customer-facing initiatives
  • Helping translate complex financial and technical concepts into clear external narratives
  • Identifying appropriate marketing channels and testing their effectiveness
  • Developing appropriate campaign and content calendars
  • Establishing marketing metrics and reporting
  • Using data and market feedback to improve activity
  • Helping determine future marketing resource and capability requirements as the organisation grows

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity. You should expect to personally execute activity rather than simply develop strategy for others to deliver.

What We're Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Strong B2B marketing experience
  • Experience taking meaningful ownership of marketing activity
  • Strong positioning and messaging capability
  • Excellent written communication skills
  • Experience creating and executing marketing plans
  • Strong commercial instincts
  • Experience working with senior leaders or founders
  • Confidence marketing technically or financially complex propositions
  • Experience operating within early-stage or high-growth environments
  • The ability to prioritise effectively when resources are limited
  • The willingness to remain hands-on while taking increasing functional ownership
  • The ability to make meaningful impact within approximately 6–8 hours per week

Experience within FinTech, financial services, payments, banking, B2B technology or another regulated environment would be particularly valuable.

We are more interested in demonstrable capability, ownership and results than job title or corporate seniority.

Engagement Structure

This is a flexible, fractional engagement of approximately 6–8 hours per week within an early-stage FinTech venture.

It is designed for someone who understands the nature of participating in an early-stage business and is comfortable with a structure centred on longer-term participation in company growth rather than a conventional package at this stage.

The role can therefore be undertaken alongside other compatible professional commitments.

Full details of the participation structure will be discussed with candidates progressing through the process.
