  • Respond to resident inquiries through phone, email, and online portals in a timely and professional manner.
  • Log and monitor resident service requests and complaints.
  • Follow up on resident requests to ensure issues are addressed and resolved.
  • Distribute notices regarding building updates, service disruptions, and other property communications.
  • Answer and route calls appropriately.
  • Monitor shared and individual email inboxes and ensure resident communication remains a consistent priority.

2. Maintenance Coordination (WORK ORDER MANAGEMENT)

  • Enter, assign, and track maintenance requests daily.
  • Coordinate maintenance requests with supers, vendors, and property management staff.
  • Consistently follow up on open work orders to ensure timely resolution.
  • Monitor outstanding requests and identify items requiring additional follow-up.
  • Maintain accurate work order status and documentation within the property management systems.

3. Vendor Access & Scheduling (COORDINATION & FOLLOW-THROUGH)

  • Manage vendor access for in-unit work, inspections, property walkthroughs, and other access requirements.
  • Coordinate schedules between vendors, residents, supers, and property management staff.
  • Communicate scheduling details and changes to the appropriate parties.
  • Follow through on vendor appointments and outstanding work until the required activity is completed.

4. Unit Turnovers & Property Operations

  • Assist with unit turnovers by scheduling, documenting, and communicating activities related to move-ins and move-outs.
  • Manage day-to-day operational activities with an understanding of budgets and expenses.
  • Ensure activities remain aligned with financial targets and cost controls.
  • Participate in weekly accounts receivable calls and resident outreach.
  • Maintain diligent and accurate notes from accounts receivable activities and outreach.

5. Property Management Systems & Process Improvement

  • Maintain and update the Property Management Software and digital tools to ensure information remains accurate at all times.
  • Keep property, resident, maintenance, and operational information properly documented.
  • Identify process inefficiencies that may affect operational efficiency or resident satisfaction.
  • Communicate and implement appropriate process improvements.
  • Provide actionable feedback to improve existing systems and contribute to technological innovation.

6. Emergency & Portfolio Support

  • Adapt to evolving company priorities and support operational needs as they arise.
  • Respond promptly to emergency situations by coordinating with residents, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Provide backup support to other properties during staff absences or periods of high demand.
  • Take on additional varied responsibilities as directed to support overall community success.
  • Remain responsive when occasional weekend or evening support is required.

Requirements

REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

  • Minimum 1 year of property management experience.
  • Previous customer service experience involving direct communication with residents, customers, or clients.
  • Hands-on experience using Yardi Voyager.
  • Hands-on experience using Maintenance IQ.
  • Experience coordinating maintenance requests and work orders.
  • Experience coordinating with vendors and property management staff.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • Able to manage multiple tasks and competing priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong relationship-building skills with residents and team members.
  • Excellent follow-through and ability to monitor issues through resolution.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced property management environment.
  • Able to work independently without requiring constant step-by-step direction.

TOOLS

  • Yardi Voyager — Required
  • Maintenance IQ — Required
  • Property Management Software
  • Google Workspace / Microsoft Office
  • Resident Communication Portals
  • Email, phone, and video communication platforms

WHAT WE VALUE MOST

  • You proactively follow up on resident requests instead of waiting for residents to ask again.
  • You keep work orders moving until they are resolved.
  • You recognize when a maintenance request is delayed, stalled, or inaccurately reflected in the system.
  • You keep Yardi Voyager and Maintenance IQ records accurate and current.
  • You communicate clearly and professionally with residents, vendors, supers, and property management staff.
  • You can manage competing priorities without losing track of details.
  • You take ownership of problems rather than simply forwarding or escalating them.
  • You identify operational issues and help improve the processes used to resolve them.
  • You remain dependable and responsive when priorities change or operational demands increase.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

  • Not a receptionist or front-desk-only position.
  • Not a general administrative assistant role.
  • Not a passive customer service position.
  • Not a maintenance technician position.
  • Not a data-entry role focused only on entering work orders.
  • Not a role where issues are simply escalated without appropriate follow-up.
  • Not suitable for candidates who require constant direction before taking action.
  • Not suitable for candidates without hands-on experience using both Yardi Voyager and Maintenance IQ.

POSITION DETAILS

  • Remote
  • Philippines-based
  • Independent contractor engagement
  • Availability during US business hours required.
  • Fast-paced property management environment with changing priorities.
  • Occasional weekend and evening working hours may be required.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

To apply, please submit:

  • An updated resume highlighting your property management and customer service experience.
  • A brief introduction video explaining your relevant experience, including your hands-on experience with Yardi Voyager and Maintenance IQ.
  • A response to the scenario below.

Scenario

  • A resident reports that a maintenance request submitted three days ago has not been completed.
  • The assigned vendor says they never received the work order, while the property management system shows the request as "In Progress."

Task

  • Describe your actions during the first 60 minutes after becoming aware of the issue.
  • Outline your process step by step.

We are evaluating:

  • Speed of decision-making
  • Resident communication
  • Vendor coordination
  • Work order follow-through
  • Ability to identify discrepancies between system records and actual status
  • Accuracy of documentation
  • Ownership and accountability
  • Ability to prioritize competing demands
  • Practical problem-solving and judgment

Clear thinking, practical judgment, and ownership are more important than writing style.

Benefits

  • PTO
  • HMO
  • Fully Remote Work

raw.title: Director, GTM Enablement
raw.excerpt: About CoLabAt CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.
raw.description:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

CoLab’s go-to-market org is scaling across sales, BDR, and customer success. This role exists to make sure that growth is backed by real capability, not just headcount.

The short version: you’re a thought partner to GTM leadership who turns half-formed observations into programs that move numbers.

Here’s what that looks like in practice. An executive team member says, “I think our BDRs need a sharper point of view on personas and messaging.” You take it from there. You figure out where the gap actually is, write the messaging yourself, design the program, roll it out alongside BDR leadership with real checkpoints, measure whether it’s landing, and then hand ongoing management over so the program doesn’t live and die with you.

Or: stage two conversion is softer than it should be. You pull the data yourself or with RevOps, form a hypothesis or two, go audit the calls in Gong, and come back with a specific fix and a plan to roll it out.

Nobody is going to hand you a spec. The value you add lives in the distance between a vague concern and a program that worked.

The Team You’ll Build

  • Technical Enablement Specialist (hiring in the near term) — owns industry enablement, discovery and demo certification, and new product enablement
  • Field Enablement Coach (planned) — call review and scoring at scale, plus individual coaching

You’ll set the strategy for both roles and make sure they’re structured to be effective. You’ll also do this work yourself. You need to be able to sit down with a stack of Gong calls and find the pattern, not just direct someone else to.

Working Across the Org

Enablement here isn’t a sales-only function. You’ll build programs that hold together across sales, BDR, customer success, marketing, and RevOps, which means a lot of your job is convening the right people and driving a rollout that everyone actually executes.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you’ll have audited the current state of enablement across the funnel, identified where reps are actually struggling using data and direct conversations, and shipped at least one program that addresses a gap you found.

By six months, new GTM hires are ramping measurably faster, there’s a repeatable onboarding program that doesn’t depend on you running it personally, and your technical enablement specialist is productive and pointed at the right problems.

By twelve months, enablement is a function the GTM org relies on rather than tolerates. You can point to specific programs and specific movement in the metrics they were built to affect, across both pre-sale and post-sale teams. Just as importantly, managers are sustaining those programs themselves.

What You’ll Own

  • Act as a thought partner to GTM leadership, taking early signals and turning them into diagnosed problems and shipped programs
  • Diagnose performance gaps using funnel data, call review, rep feedback, and partnership with RevOps
  • Build and own onboarding for new GTM hires, with a clear focus on reducing time to ramp
  • Write messaging and positioning that reps can actually use, working with marketing and technical SMEs
  • Design and deliver programs across the full lifecycle: pipeline generation, discovery, stage conversion, deal progression, onboarding, retention, and expansion
  • Roll out every program in collaboration with function owners, with structured checkpoints and measurement built in from the start rather than bolted on after
  • Equip sales, BDR, and CS managers to reinforce and sustain programs long after launch
  • Build and lead the enablement team, and set the strategy for technical enablement and field coaching
  • Measure the impact of everything against rep performance and business outcomes, and kill what isn’t working

What We’re Looking For

You’ve earned credibility with sellers. You understand what good enablement looks like because you’ve lived through the bad kind. You know what moves the needle in a deal, and you have strong opinions about designing programs people actually use.

You come with ideas and run with them. You don’t wait for a brief. You hear a problem in a pipeline review, form a point of view on it, and come back with a plan and a first version. We’ll give you real autonomy here and we expect you to use it.

You’re diagnostic. You don’t guess where the problem is. You go find it, whether that means pulling apart funnel data with RevOps or listening to twenty calls until the pattern shows up.

You can write. Not just package what marketing hands you. You can build positioning and messaging from scratch and make it sharp enough that a rep will actually say it out loud on a call.

You build things that outlive your attention. Your programs get handed to the managers who own the teams, with enough structure that they can run and reinforce them without you in the room.

You’ve led people. You’ve managed or developed a team before, and you know the difference between doing the work and building a group that can do it without you.

You’re comfortable with complexity. You don’t need to be a technical expert, but you can dig into a technical product, partner with SMEs, and translate what you learn into something a rep can use on a call tomorrow.

You Might Be Coming From

There’s more than one good path into this role. A few we’d be glad to see:

  • Sales leadership. You’ve run a team as a Director or Manager of Sales. You know exactly where reps stall because you’ve watched it happen, and you’d rather fix it at the system level than one pipeline review at a time. If you’re a sales leader who wants to move into enablement, we think that’s a strong move, not a step sideways.
  • Teaching, training, or instructional design. You understand how adults actually learn and retain things, and you’ve paired that with enough commercial exposure to hold your own in a room full of quota carriers.
  • An enablement role you’ve outgrown. You’ve built programs that worked and you want a bigger canvas, a team, and a seat closer to the strategy.

Qualifications

  • 6–8+ years across some combination of sales, sales leadership, enablement, or training and instructional design, ideally with B2B SaaS exposure
  • Enough time in or alongside a revenue team to have credibility with reps from day one
  • Experience managing or developing people
  • A track record of designing and delivering programs that produced measurable performance improvements
  • Hands-on experience with conversation intelligence tools like Gong or Chorus, and the ability to turn call review into a specific coaching plan
  • Comfort working with funnel data directly, whether alongside RevOps or on your own
  • Strong understanding of sales process and methodology, and fluency with full-funnel metrics
  • Experience enabling post-sale teams, or a clear appetite for it
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills

If this role interests you but you don’t match every line above, we’d still like to hear from you. Very few people check every box, and we’d rather see what you actually bring than screen you out on a list.

raw.description:
We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our Artist-First AI Music lab. Our team designs and builds state-of-the-art generative products for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:

  • Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
  • Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rights-holders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
  • Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for uses of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
  • Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, evaluate, and improve machine learning training and inference pipelines that power new AI-driven music experiences and help take them to fully scaled production-ready features.
  • Apply machine learning and prompt engineering knowledge across complex ML pipelines to support rich user experiences involving large language models.
  • Create evaluation frameworks, including LLM-as-judge pipelines, to measure quality and build fast feedback loops that enable rapid and confident iteration.
  • Partner with music subject-matter experts to bootstrap training and reference data, including synthetic generation, expert curation, and taxonomy design.
  • Build scalable systems that balance experimentation velocity with production rigor, ensuring strong performance, reliability, and latency at Spotify scale.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Science teams to connect evaluation frameworks with real-world usage signals and continuously improve model quality.
  • Contribute to technical direction and engineering best practices across model deployment, observability, experimentation, and production infrastructure.
  • Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, design, and music industry partners to shape entirely new listening experiences for artists and fans.

Who You Are

About us:

Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

👥 Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.

🚀 Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.

🤝 One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

About the role:

Foodsmart is seeking compassionate and mission-driven Registered Dietitians (RDs) with active Certifications in Washington to join our growing Foodsmart Nutrition Network. As a Foodsmart RD, you’ll deliver virtual Medical Nutrition Therapy (MNT) and personalized care to members—many of whom are Medicaid participants or facing food insecurity.
This is a unique opportunity to make a measurable impact on health equity—empowering individuals and families to live healthier lives through access, affordability, and education.
Candidates must reside in and work within the US.

  • Ongoing education: We offer CPEU webinars on a monthly basis for internal RDs.

You Will:

  • Help members stretch their food budgets and make the most of what they have
  • Guide access to affordable, healthy groceries through our online marketplace
  • Connect members with local food and nutrition resources
  • Support sustainable meal planning and healthy habits for families
  • Deliver MNT to manage or prevent chronic conditions
  • Provide personalized virtual nutrition care via secure video and messaging

You Have:

  • Active credentialing as a Registered Dietitian by the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR)
  • Certification in WA State
  • Willingness to obtain state licenses in high demand states (reimbursed by Foodsmart)
  • Ability to work in the U.S.
  • A computer, high speed internet and a smart phone
  • At least 15 hours of weekly availability for patients (weekends and evenings count!)- note that while this role asks for 15 hours, we have other roles requiring less availability- please apply even if you can't meet this requirement!

Compensation

  • $52.80 for a 1-hour visit; Most of our visits are scheduled for one hour.

The ALTA Survey Project Coordinator coordinates the day-to-day execution of ALTA surveys, zoning, and commercial real estate due diligence projects from project setup through final delivery. This role serves as the central point of coordination between clients, survey vendors, field teams, municipalities, and internal project managers to keep projects moving, information organized, schedules on track, and deliverables completed accurately and on time.

This is a project coordination role - not a surveying position. The Coordinator does not perform technical surveying work but is responsible for managing the information, communication, scheduling, documentation, and logistics required to successfully complete each assignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set up and maintain ALTA survey, zoning, and due diligence projects in internal project management systems, ensuring project information is accurate and current.

  • Communicate with municipal departments to obtain records, requirements, and other project information.
  • Track project status, outstanding information, scheduling issues, proposals, and deliverables to keep assignments moving toward completion.
  • Review client comments and project requirements and communicate necessary revisions or follow-up items to vendors and internal teams.
  • Receive, organize, and distribute survey and zoning deliverables for appropriate technical review.

  • Maintain accurate project, client, vendor, and contact information across company systems.
  • Proactively identify delays, missing information, or project issues and escalate significant concerns to the Senior Project Coordinator or Project Manager.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and confidence communicating with clients, vendors, municipalities, and internal teams.
  • Ability to read and understand project documents, municipal requirements, and technical information.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify missing or inconsistent information.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while maintaining consistent communication with the project team.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and web-based project management systems; ability to quickly learn new software and internal platforms.
  • Experience with ALTA surveys, zoning, commercial real estate due diligence, land surveying, construction, or engineering is a plus.

Work Environment

This is primarily a remote, computer-based project coordination position requiring frequent communication with clients, vendors, municipalities, field personnel, and internal project teams. Occasional overtime may be required based on project demands.

Imagine being part of a team that supports the backbone of the electric grid. As a Structural Engineer – Substation, you will play a critical role in the planning, design, and delivery of substation infrastructure across Olsson’s Transmission and Substation team.

In this role, you will lead the structural design of substation foundations, steel structures, and equipment supports, contributing to projects that strengthen and modernize power delivery systems. You will collaborate closely with electrical engineers, designers, and project managers throughout all phases of project delivery.

This position is ideal for a structural engineer who enjoys technically challenging work, mentoring others, and contributing meaningfully to essential infrastructure projects.

You bring to the team:

This position will drive profitable revenue growth, expand FDH’s position across customer programs and platforms, protect existing business, and strengthen FDH’s role as a strategic supply-chain partner. The Strategic Account Manager will establish senior-level relationships throughout the customer organization, develop a multiyear account growth strategy, and lead the pursuit of new business across FDH’s product and service portfolio. This position will direct the cross-functional execution of account priorities by aligning Sales, Product Management, Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, and executive leadership around the customer’s current requirements and long-term objectives.

What You'll Do (Responsibilities)

Strategic Account Ownership

  • Define and execute the account strategy for a designated key customer, aligning customer priorities with FDH’s commercial objectives, product capabilities, and long-term growth strategy.
  • Serve as the principal commercial leader and primary point of accountability for the overall customer relationship.
  • Establish FDH as a strategic partner by delivering solutions that support the customer’s technical, operational, program, and supply-chain objectives.
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of the customer business strategy, organizational structure, programs, platforms, sourcing priorities, technical requirements, and growth plans.
  • Establish multiyear objectives for revenue growth, gross margin, market penetration, customer retention, and strategic account development.
  • Provide executive leadership with regular assessments of account performance, strategic opportunities, competitive threats, and required investments.

Account Growth and Business Development

  • Develop and execute a formal account growth plan identifying addressable market, target programs, product expansion opportunities, competitive position, commercial priorities, and specific growth initiatives.
  • Drive new business development across customer programs, platforms, sites, and functional organizations.
  • Expand market share through cross-selling, new product introductions, engineering design-in activity, supplier consolidation, and value-added supply-chain solutions.
  • Identify business currently awarded to competitors and develop targeted strategies to capture or displace incumbent positions.
  • Lead the qualification, prioritization, and advancement of strategic opportunities from initial identification through award and implementation.
  • Develop opportunity-capture plans that define customer requirements, decision criteria, competitive dynamics, value proposition, commercial strategy, internal resources, milestones, and ownership.
  • Build and maintain a robust pipeline sufficient to achieve the account’s short- and long-term growth objectives.
  • Partner with Product Management and Procurement to align FDH’s supplier relationships, product portfolio, and inventory strategy with emerging customer demand.

Executive and Customer Relationship Development

  • Establish and expand relationships with key decision-makers and influencers across procurement, engineering, supply chain, program management, operations, quality, and executive leadership.
  • Develop a comprehensive stakeholder strategy that identifies decision authority, technical influence, organizational priorities, and relationship coverage.
  • Facilitate executive alignment between FDH and the designated customer to advance strategic initiatives, resolve business issues, and strengthen the long-term partnership.
  • Lead customer engagement at all organizational levels, including strategic planning sessions, commercial negotiations, program reviews, and executive business reviews.
  • Maintain visibility into organizational changes, investment priorities, sourcing strategies, program schedules, budget cycles, and other developments affecting the account.
  • Represent FDH at customer locations, industry events, supplier meetings, and other strategic business engagements.

Cross-Functional Account Execution

  • Lead the cross-functional FDH account team and establish clear accountability for commercial, operational, technical, quality, and service commitments.
  • Translate customer strategy and requirements into coordinated actions across Sales, Product Management, Supply Chain, Operations, Quality, Finance, and executive leadership.
  • Direct internal account reviews to evaluate performance, advance growth initiatives, resolve execution gaps, and align resources with account priorities.
  • Secure the organizational resources and executive support required to pursue strategic opportunities and fulfill customer commitments.
  • Escalate material commercial, operational, quality, or relationship risks and lead the development of timely resolution plans.
  • Ensure customer commitments, internal action items, and strategic initiatives are supported by clear ownership, milestones, and performance expectations.

Commercial Strategy and Financial Performance

  • Own the account’s revenue, gross margin, profitability, pipeline, backlog, and forecast performance.
  • Develop and execute pricing, negotiation, and contract-renewal strategies that support profitable growth and protect FDH’s commercial position.
  • Evaluate business opportunities based on strategic value, revenue potential, margin contribution, operational requirements, contractual exposure, and execution risk.
  • Identify and address margin erosion, pricing pressure, unfavorable commercial terms, and underperforming business.
  • Develop accurate revenue and demand forecasts using customer intelligence, program schedules, backlog, pipeline activity, and market conditions.
  • Establish commercial strategies for major sourcing events, requests for quotation, contract negotiations, and competitive pursuits.
  • Maintain complete and accurate account, pipeline, forecast, and opportunity information within the company’s CRM and reporting systems.

Business Retention and Competitive Strategy

  • Protect the account’s existing business through proactive relationship management, performance oversight, and competitive positioning.
  • Identify emerging risks related to competitor activity, customer sourcing initiatives, supplier changes, pricing, quality, delivery, contract renewals, and product displacement.
  • Develop and execute account-defense strategies before existing business becomes subject to competitive sourcing or performance-related risk.
  • Monitor competitive activity and develop differentiated strategies based on FDH’s product breadth, supplier relationships, technical capabilities, responsiveness, and supply-chain solutions.
  • Maintain an account risk assessment with defined mitigation actions, accountable owners, and completion timelines.

Strategic Business Reviews and Performance Governance

  • Lead formal Quarterly Business Reviews and other strategic customer reviews focused on performance, growth, risk, and long-term partnership objectives.
  • Present account performance across revenue, growth, delivery, quality, service, open actions, pipeline development, and strategic initiatives.
  • Use business reviews to advance joint priorities, secure alignment on future programs, and identify opportunities for expanded partnership.
  • Establish and monitor corrective actions for performance gaps, customer concerns, and unresolved commitments.
  • Track account performance against established strategic, commercial, and operational objectives and adjust the account plan as required.

Customer and Market Intelligence

  • Develop actionable intelligence regarding customer programs, platforms, technical requirements, sourcing plans, decision processes, and competitive environment.
  • Identify the individuals and functions that influence product specifications, supplier selection, commercial awards, and program decisions.
  • Anticipate future customer requirements and translate those insights into product, supplier, inventory, and commercial strategies for FDH.
  • Communicate relevant customer and market intelligence to internal stakeholders to support investment decisions, resource planning, and opportunity development.
  • Ensure material customer intelligence is documented and incorporated into account planning, forecasting, and business-development activities.

What You Bring (Qualifications & Skills):

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, supply chain, or a related discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in strategic account management, business development, or complex solution sales.
  • Aerospace, defense, space, electronics distribution, electronic components, or highly engineered products experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing growth strategies for large, complex, and technically demanding customers.
  • Proven record of expanding revenue, gross margin, share of wallet, and executive-level customer relationships.
  • Experience leading complex opportunity pursuits, commercial negotiations, and multiyear account strategies.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including experience with pricing, profitability, forecasting, backlog, pipeline management, and contract terms.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive execution within a matrixed organization.
  • Working knowledge of electronic components, interconnect products, aerospace hardware, or related product categories preferred.
  • Ability and willingness to travel frequently in support of customer and business requirements.

Special Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (Green Card holder) orasylee/refugee status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) required.
  • ITAR requirement
  • 120.15. Some positions will require current U.S. Citizenship due to contract requirements.

This position requires access to information that is subject to compliance with the International Traffic Arms Regulations (“ITAR”) and/or the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). In order to comply with the requirements of the ITAR and/or the EAR, applicants will be asked to provide specific documentation to verify U.S. person status under the ITAR and the EAR. A “U.S. person” according to their definition is a U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), or protected individual such as a refugee, or asylee. See 22 CFR

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You’ll work closely with Engineering Managers, Tech PMs, other Competence Managers, Area Managers, People Business Partners, and technical communities across H&M Group.

Together, you’ll ensure that we have the right people, skills, and capabilities to meet today’s delivery needs while preparing for tomorrow’s challenges.

You’ll be part of a collaborative environment where people leadership and technical expertise come together to shape how we develop talent and build sustainable engineering capabilities.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with…

  • Expertise in core FICO modules: GL, AP, AR, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, and Internal Orders.

  • Previous experience in a senior engineering or technical leadership role within areas such as software, applications, data, platforms, or related technologies.

  • Experience in people leadership, coaching, mentoring, or technical talent development.

  • Experience with workforce, resource, or organisational planning and the ability to connect capability needs with business priorities.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence and collaborate across different organisational levels.

  • A data-driven approach to identifying capability gaps, measuring progress, and supporting organisational decisions.

And people who are…

  • Empowering – you trust others, listen actively, and create space for people to grow and take ownership.
  • Innovative – you are curious, open to new ideas, and comfortable challenging established ways of working.
  • Improvement-oriented – you take action, learn continuously, and turn insights into meaningful improvements.

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits and extensive opportunities for development, learning, and career growth around the globe.

  • Work with talented and diverse people across a global technology organisation.
  • Shape the future capabilities of our engineering community and make a tangible impact on people's careers.
  • Access opportunities for continuous learning, professional development, and internal mobility.
  • Be part of a culture that values collaboration, empowerment, innovation, improvement, resourcefulness, honesty, and clarity.

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

raw.description:
340B Program ManagerRemote | Full-Time

Who We Are

NuvemRx helps community health providers deliver on their mission by simplifying the complexity of pharmacy operations, with a suite of scalable solutions that integrate software, intelligence, and expert support to illuminate savings, expand access, and elevate patient care.

What We Are Looking For

At NuvemRx, we hold a high bar because our work directly impacts patient care. We look for people who embody our core values:

  • Mission Always: Every choice is a chance to serve our customers and improve healthcare
  • Be a Pioneer: Take initiative, solve problems, and build what does not yet exist
  • Do the Right Thing the Right Way: Lead with integrity, compliance, and thoughtful execution
  • Stronger Together: Own your role, collaborate deeply, and elevate the team

We are also a fast-growing company, which means you bring strong ownership, comfort with ambiguity, resilience, and a bias toward action.

About the Role

The 340B Program Manager is responsible for the oversight, administration, and ongoing compliance monitoring of the 340B Drug Pricing Program for assigned Covered Entity (CE) clients supported by NuvemRx. This position supports a variety of 340B-eligible organizations, including Federally Qualified Health Centers, Disproportionate Share Hospitals, FQHC Look-Alikes, and other eligible provider organizations.

The 340B Program Manager ensures program compliance with HRSA guidance, federal regulations, manufacturer requirements, and internal operational standards. This role oversees compliance monitoring activities, audit readiness, operational workflows, and program documentation while serving as a key liaison between clients and internal operational teams. The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and capable of independently managing multiple client accounts and priorities in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

What You'll Do

Program Administration & Compliance

  • Manage and oversee day-to-day administration of assigned 340B programs to ensure compliance with HRSA guidance and applicable federal and state regulations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact and compliance resource for assigned Covered Entities regarding 340B program operations, audit readiness, and regulatory requirements.
  • Conduct routine compliance reviews, internal audits, account monitoring, reconciliations, and operational assessments to identify potential risks or compliance concerns.
  • Monitor program activity, data integrity, accumulations, replenishment activity, and operational workflows to ensure compliant program administration.
  • Support and manage 340B ESP submission activities and manufacturer inquiry resolution processes as needed.
  • Develop, maintain, and update policies, procedures, workflows, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to support compliant 340B program operations.

Audit Readiness & Risk Management

  • Support preparation for HRSA audits, manufacturer audits, payer reviews, and internal compliance assessments, including documentation collection, audit support, and corrective action tracking.
  • Maintain accurate, organized, and audit-ready documentation related to compliance monitoring, operational activities, and client program management.
  • Analyze program data and operational performance to identify opportunities for process improvement, operational efficiency, compliant savings optimization, and risk mitigation.

Client Engagement & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Covered Entity leadership, pharmacy operations, finance, wholesalers, manufacturers, contract pharmacies, and third-party administrators (TPAs) to support compliant and effective program operations.
  • Participate in client meetings, compliance discussions, operational reviews, onboarding activities, and strategic program initiatives.
  • Provide education and operational guidance to clients and internal stakeholders regarding 340B program requirements and best practices.

What You Bring

Core Capabilities

  • Deep working knowledge of the 340B Drug Pricing Program, including HRSA guidance, compliance requirements, and program operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client accounts and complex compliance workstreams simultaneously, with high accuracy and accountability.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret program data, identify trends, and surface actionable insights.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both frontline pharmacy staff and executive-level stakeholders.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to maintain audit-ready documentation standards.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience managing 340B programs for FQHCs, DSH hospitals, FQHC Look-Alikes, or other covered entities.
  • Familiarity with 340B third-party administrators (TPAs), ESP submissions, and manufacturer compliance processes.
  • Experience supporting HRSA audits or internal compliance assessments.
  • Background in pharmacy operations, healthcare compliance, or healthcare administration.
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools and 340B software platforms.

Who Thrives in This Role

  • You are a compliance-minded professional who takes ownership of program integrity without being prompted.
  • You are energized by complex regulatory environments and find purpose in keeping programs airtight for clients that serve vulnerable patient populations.
  • You proactively identify risks before they become problems and bring a clear, recommended path forward.
  • You build trust with clients through consistent expertise, responsiveness, and follow-through.
  • You thrive in a role that requires both deep subject matter expertise and strong cross-functional collaboration.

Benefits

  • Remote-first work environment
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible PTO
  • Medical, dental, vision
  • 401(k) with match
  • Life and disability coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Mission-driven team
  • WFH stipend

Compensation

The expected base compensation for this role is $80,000-85,000 per year.

Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as skills, location, and internal equity.

NuvemRx complies with applicable pay transparency laws. The compensation range listed reflects the expected base salary at the time of posting, and actual compensation may vary.

NuvemRx is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

NuvemRx is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at .

A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Role Summary

As a Technical Community Support with SmartSimple’s Essential Support team at Foundant, you'll be the voice of customer support and a critical link between our clients and internal teams. You’ll provide prompt, professional, and knowledgeable technical support to help mission-driven organizations succeed with our software. This role combines troubleshooting expertise with a passion for customer success, operating as a technical problem-solver and customer advocate who helps organizations achieve their missions more efficiently and effectively.

Where You’ll Work:

  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.

WhatYou’llDo:

  • Respond to and triage inbound support tickets, applying initial diagnosis and prioritization based on severity and SLA.
  • Troubleshoot common SmartSimple configuration, workflow, and reporting issues, resolving independently where possible.
  • Escalate complex or unresolved issues to Subject Matter Experts with clear documentation of steps already taken.
  • Maintain accurate, timely ticket notes and status updates in the ticketing system (powered by Zendesk) to support reporting on KPIs and knowledge continuity.
  • Maintain a high level of communication with all levels of client interaction to ensure proactive, solution-oriented problem identification and resolution.
  • Test fixes provided by the Engineering team and incorporate them into client systems.
  • Advocate new platform features and assist clients in adopting these through upgrades, configuration changes, or training. Provide instruction and documentation to ensure the technical success of these initiatives.  
  • Facilitate relationships across client success, internal teams, and departments to strengthen partnerships.
  • Contributor to continuous process improvement within and between all areas of Support.
  • Participate in team huddles, training sessions, knowledge-sharing activities and process improvement discussions.
  • Meet individual and team KPIs for ticket volume, response time, and customer satisfaction.
  • Some travel may be required (estimated less than 10%).
  • Other duties as assigned.

WhatYou’llNeed:

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Engineering, Sciences, Mathematics (STEM) field.
  • 1–2 years of experience in a customer-facing technical support, or SaaS support role.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
  • Comfortable learning new software platforms quickly; prior exposure to SaaS, CRM, or grants management tools is a plus.
  • Solid troubleshooting instincts - able to isolate a problem, test hypotheses, and document findings.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing a queue of concurrent tickets.
  • Demonstrable success in thinking strategically, executing tactically, while providing consistent and high levels of client satisfaction and retention in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Comfortable working in a metric-driven environment.

Required Technical Skills

  • Basic understanding of cloud and SaaS terminology.
  • Fundamental knowledge of databases and SQL - able to read basic queries, understand table relationships, and assist with simple data troubleshooting.
  • Field data storage concepts - understanding of data types, field mappings, and how data is stored and retrieved in database systems.
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge - able to read and understand HTML/CSS code, troubleshoot formatting issues.
  • JavaScript fundamentals - able to recognize JavaScript syntax, understand basic functions and logic, and troubleshoot workflow automations.
  • Workflow automation concepts - understanding of conditional logic, triggers, actions, and how automated workflows function in SaaS.
  • Integration protocols and SSO (Single Sign-On) - familiarity with how external systems connect via integrations, including SMTP, SFTP, API connections, and authentication methods.
  • Data analytics fundamentals - able to interpret reports, understand data visualizations, and assist with report troubleshooting and configuration.

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with SaaS, SmartSimple or similar technology platforms.
  • Experience with a ticketing platform such as Zendesk.
  • Exposure to the nonprofit, philanthropic, or grants management sector.
Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
  • At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
  • We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
  • With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
  • We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
  • As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
  • You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
  • Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation.

Foundant is also committed to providing accommodations throughout the interview and employment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process. If you have accessibility requirements during the recruitment process and require accommodation, please contact .

As one of the leading writers of Federal Crop Insurance, AgriSompo North America combines industry experience, resources, capital and talent to deliver both traditional and innovative crop insurance and productivity tools to farmers, ranchers, insurers and agribusinesses in the United States. Our organization operates within a culture rooted in ethics, integrity and a belief that accountability, collaboration and agility are crucial to long-term success.

AgriSompo North America is a part of AgriSompo, Sompo International’s global agriculture platform. This platform is an integrated underwriting, technology and distribution platform delivering innovate insurance and reinsurance solutions to agriculture partners worldwide. Sompo International, AgriSompo’s parent company, is a global organization driven by its core values, a carrier that holds promise, trust and the commitment to protect. Through operating subsidiaries, Sompo International writes agriculture, casualty and other specialty, professional lines, property, marine/energy and aviation lines of insurance and catastrophe, property, casualty, professional lines and specialty lines of reinsurance.

As a leading provider of crop insurance and other agricultural risk management tools, we recognize that our success is derived directly from those whose contributions matter most: our people. AgriSompo North America has major offices in Lenexa, Kansas and Des Moines, Iowa as well as regional offices around the country. A shared commitment to integrity, accountability, collaboration and agility define our culture, and we strive to create exceptional value for our clients and shareholders and maintain AgriSompo North America as a desirable place to work.

Job Description

Are you looking for your next opportunity?

Sompo has a unique opportunity for a WFRPClaims Specialist in our West Region team.

As a Whole Farm Revenue Protection (WFRP) Claims Specialist will provide exceptional customer service to agents and producers by accurately and efficiently auditing and verifying WFRP Claims. You'll serve as an expert in areas of WFRP claims procedure and auditing. The WFRP Claims Specialist will also provide research and verification of claims/policy data, troubleshoot identified problems or issues, and train other staff as needed in the area of WFRP Claims.

Location: This position may be based remotely in Washington, California, Illinois, Texas, Florida, Kentucky, or Oregon,with consideration also given to candidates located in other U.S. state. We strive for collaboration which is why we offer a work environmentwhere our employees thrive and develop long lasting careers.

Our business, your impact, our opportunity:

What you’ll be doing:

  • Audit, review, and process WFRP claims accurately and timely in accordance with policy requirements, standard operating procedures, and regulatory guidelines

  • Research and resolve complex claims, policy, and system issues, including PASS errors, with limited supervision

  • Serve as a resource on WFRP claims procedures, policy interpretation, and related underwriting and claims processes

  • Partner with underwriters, adjusters, compliance staff, agents, and producers to resolve questions and support effective claim handling

  • Apply working knowledge of WFRP, MPCI, FCIC, NCIS, RMA, and related manuals, handbooks, and policy documentation to support claim decisions

  • Support continuous improvement by identifying system issues, assisting with training development, and helping implement process enhancements

  • Maintain knowledge of regional crops, farming practices, and internal procedures to support strong claims performance

  • Adapt to changing priorities, systems, and business needs while maintaining strong research quality and timely execution.

  • Travel as needed, up to 25%

What you’ll bring:

  • Advanced experience in MPCI underwriting, claims auditing, and/or claims processing required

  • 5+ years of MPCI or WFRP crop insurance experience preferred

  • Advanced knowledge of FCIC MPCI and WFRP policies, with the ability to interpret policy provisions and supporting documentation

  • Knowledge of IRS federal tax forms, company policies and procedures, and related claims or underwriting systems preferred

  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe Acrobat

  • Strong analytical, mathematical, organizational, and problem-solving skills

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work well across all levels inside and outside the organization

  • Strong customer service skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently and as part of a team

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality, adapt to change, and work effectively through complex issues

Physical Requirements & Work Conditions

  • Sedentary work. Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time.

  • Ability to stand or sit constantly/continuously.

  • Hearing. Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication, and to make the discriminations in sound.

  • The employee is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading; visual inspection involving small defects, small parts, and/or operation of machines (including inspection); using measurement devices; and/or assembly or fabrication parts at distances close to the eyes.

Environmental Conditions

  • The work environment described here are meant to be representative of those an employee would normally encounter while performing the essential functions of this job.

  • The physical environment requires the employee to work inside where there are limited extremes to heat and/or cold; moderate noise; a normal office environment.

  • Travel required for meetings and trainings.

Salary Range: $70,000 - $90,000. Actual compensation for this role will depend on several factors including the cost of living associated with your work location, your qualifications, skills, competencies, and relevant experience.

At Sompo, we recognize that the talent, skills, and commitment of our employees drive our success. This is why we offer competitive, high-quality compensation and benefit programs to eligible employees.

Our compensation program is built on a foundation that promotes a pay-for-performance culture, resulting in higher incentive awards, on average, when the Company does well and lower incentive awards when the Company underperforms. The total compensation opportunity for all regular, full-time employees is a combination of base salary and incentives that gets adjusted upfront based on overall Company performance with final awards based on individual performance.

We continuously evaluate and update our benefit programs to ensure that our plans remain competitive and meet the needs of our employees and their dependents. Below is a summary of our current comprehensive U.S. benefit programs:

  • Two medical plans to choose from, including a Traditional PPO & a Consumer Driven Health Plan with a Health Savings account providing a competitive employer contribution
  • Pharmacy benefits with mail order options
  • Dental benefits including orthodontia benefits for adults and children
  • Vision benefits
  • Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Company-paid Life & AD&D benefits, including the option to purchase Supplemental life coverage for employee, spouse & children
  • Company-paid Disability benefits with very competitive salary continuation payments
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with competitive employer contributions
  • Competitive paid-time-off programs, including company-paid holidays
  • Competitive Parental Leave Benefits & Adoption Assistance program
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Tax-Free Commuter Benefit
  • Tuition Reimbursement & Professional Qualification benefits

Who we are and what we stand for:

At Sompo, our shared purpose is to create meaningful value for clients, communities, and each other. We strive to foster a workplace where everyone feels respected, included, and empowered to excel. As a global organization, we embrace diversity and champion equal opportunity. Guided by our core values—Accountability, Agility, Collaboration, Development, and Integrity—we build trust and support one another to achieve our goals worldwide. Life at Sompo page

Our values come to life in how we hire and grow talent. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and organizational need, and we strive to ensure equitable access to opportunities so everyone can do their best work. If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please contact the recruiter in charge.

raw.excerpt: Como Pessoa Pesquisadora de Produto de Métodos Mistos, você moldará nossos produtos de língua de sinais alimentados por IA, desde a concepção até como eles aprendem com o mundo real — conectando experiência do usuário, dados comportamentais e avaliação de modelos em um sistema de aprendizado unificado.
raw.description:
Como Pessoa Pesquisadora de Produto de Métodos Mistos, você moldará nossos produtos de língua de sinais alimentados por IA, desde a concepção até como eles aprendem com o mundo real — conectando experiência do usuário, dados comportamentais e avaliação de modelos em um sistema de aprendizado unificado. Seu trabalho influenciará diretamente as decisões de produto, a qualidade do modelo e a confiança do usuário para as comunidades surdas e com deficiência auditiva. A maioria das organizações trata pesquisa, análise e feedback como funções separadas. O resultado é um insight fragmentado, aprendizado lento e oportunidades perdidas. Estamos adotando uma abordagem diferente. Você fará parte de uma equipe multifuncional de Insights trabalhando na intersecção de IA/ML, desenvolvimento de produtos e acessibilidade. Fazemos parceria estreita com Produto, IA/ML, Design e a comunidade Surda — porque os usuários não são apenas participantes; eles são essenciais para construir sistemas melhores.

Trabalhamos todos os dias com gente muito talentosa focada no mesmo propósito: tornar o mundo um lugar mais acessível e justo para todas as pessoas. Valorizamos a colaboratividade e temos um gigante espírito de equipe, mesmo à distância, temos muita proximidade com todos e todas. Venha compartilhar conhecimento e impactar a vida de milhares de pessoas no Brasil e em todo o planeta. Venha ser HandTalker!

Então se você quer fazer parte dessa missão de quebrar barreiras de comunicação entre pessoas surdas e ouvintes através da tecnologia no mundo inteiro, trabalhe conosco e conheça mais daHand Talk!

  • Faça parte de um time AAA.
  • Temos um excelente clima de trabalho, com o tempero necessário para você viver uma grande experiência :)
  • Trabalhe lado a lado com alguns dos empreendedores sociais mais reconhecidos no Brasil e no mundo.
  • Tenha o protagonismo na sua carreira em um ambiente com projetos desafiadores.
  • Um ambiente altamente desafiador e colaborativo.
  • Possibilidade de aprendizado e crescimento acelerado, com oportunidade de implementar projetos que serão cases de sucesso no mundo digital.

Visite nosso blog, canal no Youtube, redes sociais ou dá um Google aí que também vai achar muita coisa bacana sobre a Hand Talk!

Responsabilidades Principais:

  • Projetar e executar pesquisas de métodos mistos de ponta a ponta em múltiplas frentes de trabalho de produtos de IA.
  • Traduzir questões ambíguas de produtos e modelos em planos de pesquisa claros e acionáveis — abrangendo descoberta, testes de conceito e avaliação de experiência.
  • Estudar como os usuários surdos vivenciam a comunicação em contextos reais, utilizando métodos moderados e não moderados.
  • Elaborar pesquisas e métricas de experiência que possam ser acompanhadas ao longo do tempo; estabelecer relatórios recorrentes que acumulem aprendizado, e não estudos isolados.
  • Definir sinais comportamentais e requisitos de instrumentação em parceria com as equipes de Produto e Engenharia.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de IA/ML e Insights para definir os critérios de sucesso (o que significa um "bom resultado") — contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de frameworks de medição da qualidade da interpretação e da eficácia da comunicação.
  • Implementar sistemas de feedback e cadências de acompanhamento para recursos recém-lançados; garantir que os insights orientem continuamente as decisões de produtos e modelos.
  • Comunicar os resultados de forma clara por meio de entregáveis focados e direcionados à tomada de decisões.
  • Colaborar de forma multifuncional com as equipes de Produto, IA/ML, Design e partes interessadas (stakeholders) da comunidade para formular perguntas que conectem os sinais de experiência à melhoria dos modelos.
  • Manter práticas de pesquisa que sejam respeitosas, transparentes e significativas para os participantes.

Habilidades Técnicas:

  • 6–8+ anos de experiência em pesquisa aplicada em ambientes de produto ou tecnologia
  • Forte experiência em pesquisa qualitativa (moderada + não moderada), design e análise de pesquisas, e análise básica comportamental ou de produto
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com diversos métodos e selecionar a abordagem certa para o problema em questão
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e trabalho com métricas de produto e experiência
  • Conforto na construção de sistemas de medição leves (rastreamento, painéis, relatórios)
  • Fortes habilidades destorytellinge comunicação
  • Inglês avançado para conversação

Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Curiosidade, colaboratividade, estrutura e orientação para a ação
  • Confortável trabalhando em ambiguidade e em ambientes de estágio inicial
  • Foco no impacto — não apenas na produção (output)
  • Experiência trabalhando com comunidades onde confiança e sensibilidade cultural são importantes
  • Forte compromisso com práticas de pesquisa inclusivas e éticas

﻿Diferenciais:

  • Proficiência em ASL (Língua Americana de Sinais) é um grande diferencial, mas não obrigatória; se não for fluente, deve demonstrar forte discernimento ao trabalhar com intérpretes e garantir acesso total à comunicação em todas as atividades de pesquisa.

Informações adicionais

NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Contrato CLT: Sua segurança e todos os seus direitos garantidos desde o primeiro dia.
  • Cartão de Benefícios Caju (R$ 1.160,00): Flexibilidade para usar seu saldo como preferir: refeição, alimentação, home office, cultura e mobilidade!
  • Trabalho Remoto - De Onde Você Estiver! Tenha a liberdade de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil, com flexibilidade e conforto.
  • Plano de Saúde SulAmérica
  • Plano Odontológico SulAmérica
  • Seguro de Vida SulAmérica
  • Consultas online com especialistas na palma da sua mão através do Conexa Saúde – telemedicina.
  • Wellhub: Para trabalhar sempre na sua melhor versão!
  • Recesso Estendido de Final de Ano: Celebre as festas com mais tranquilidade! Desfrute de um período prolongado para recarregar as energias com sua família e amigos.
  • Day off de aniversário: Para que você tenha um dia de descanso especial no mês do seu aniversário!
  • Licença Parental Estendida: Apoio e tempo de qualidade para quem está construindo ou aumentando a família.
  • Desenvolvimento Profissional Contínuo: Acesse plataformas de ponta como CS Academy e LinkedIn Learning, além de ajuda de custo anual para cursos e capacitações na sua área. Invista em você!
  • Parceria com universidades: Apoio para ir além através de descontos e sorteios!
  • Capacitação em Libras: Aprenda essa língua tão importante para a nossa comunidade!
  • English Pass: Aprendizado de Inglês para continuar evoluindo na carreira!
  • Material de trabalho enviado já no seu kit Onboarding.

raw.title: Video Editor
raw.excerpt: Who We Are Sunco. com is a leading online lighting retailer headquartered in Valencia, CA.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Sunco.com is a leading online lighting retailer headquartered in Valencia, CA. Thanks to our amazing and talented employees, we are proud to be one of the largest online lighting retailers in the US. We deeply value our collaborative, open, and people-first culture and are invested in making Sunco a positive place where our team members thrive every day. With our new state-of-the-art distribution center in Georgia, we continue to expand our reach and enhance our ability to serve our customers with excellence and efficiency. Join us and be part of a dynamic team that is lighting the way to a brighter future.

What We Do

We light up the world, literally. Customers have chosen Sunco to provide millions of LED lights and trust us for our exceptional customer service, eco-conscious product expertise, and unmatched value.

About the role

We’re looking for a talented Video Editor to join Sunco’s Marketing team and support the growth of our video content pipeline. This role will focus on editing both short-form and long-form videos for ads, social media, tutorials, and brand storytelling.

You’ll collaborate closely with content managers, writers, designers, and videographers to bring video concepts to life while maintaining Sunco’s brand standards and performance goals.

What you'll do

  • Collaborate with content managers, writers, designers, and videographers to develop video concepts, edit plans, and basic storyboards.
  • Edit short-form and long-form videos for ads, promotions, tutorials, and brand storytelling using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar tools.
  • Create platform-native edits and variations for Amazon, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Vimeo, and other channels—optimizing for format, length, hooks, and calls to action.
  • Ensure consistency in branding, messaging, tone, and visual style across all video content.
  • Add graphics, subtitles, simple motion design, and basic animations to improve clarity and engagement.
  • Perform basic color correction and audio cleanup, including music, sound effects, and voice balancing, while following licensing and brand guidelines.
  • Optimize video files, thumbnails, titles, and metadata for SEO and discoverability.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends, creator best practices, and competitor content, and suggest new formats or creative tests.
  • Organize and maintain video assets, project files, and exports for efficient collaboration and reuse.
  • Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and partner teams while maintaining quality and timelines.
  • Manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously, communicating clearly about progress and risks.
  • Partner with internal and external videographers or agencies when needed, providing clear briefs and edit requirements.
  • Work regular hours that substantially overlap with 8:00 am – 5:00 pm Pacific Time and attend scheduled meetings.
  • Support other video and content-related tasks as needed.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in film production or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Proven experience as a video editor with a strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating end-to-end edits for digital channels, especially advertising.
  • Experience editing content from a variety of sources, including product footage, lifestyle shoots, UGC, and screen recordings.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, with moderate experience in 2D motion graphics.
  • Strong understanding of pacing, visual storytelling, composition, and motion design.
  • Familiarity with sound design basics, including sound effects, dialogue cleanup, music selection, and audio mixing.
  • Experience tailoring content for social media and marketplace platforms, especially short-form formats.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a distributed, multicultural team environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Passion for staying current with video trends, tools, and best practices.
  • Experience with product, ecommerce, or B2B video campaigns is a plus.
  • Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken).
  • Ability and willingness to work hours that substantially overlap with 8:00 am – 5:00 pm Pacific Time.

Key Attributes:

  • High level of integrity and dedication to quality.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong commitment to process improvement and operational excellence

Additional Requirements:

  • Availability to work between 8 AM to 5 PM Pacific Time
  • Reliable internet access and a private remote workstation.

How to apply:

  • Please send or attach your resume to the application
    • Kindly ensure that your resume is submitted in English, as applications with resumes in other languages will not be considered.

About the Company

Sunco Lighting is an online lighting retailer based in Valencia, CA. Thanks to our amazing and talented employees, today we are one of the largest online lighting retailers in the US. We value our collaborative, open, and people-first culture deeply, and we are invested in making Sunco a positive place where our team members thrive every day.

Job Type: Full-time , International Contractor

DISCLAIMER: This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, skills, efforts, requirements, or working conditions associated with the job. While this is intended to accurately reflect the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks be performed as assigned.

Sunco Lighting Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and complies with Ban the Box laws, which prohibit us from inquiring about an applicant's criminal history until after a conditional job offer has been made. We also prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Sunco values privacy as a top priority. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of our application, please view our Sunco Privacy Notice
